title: Beyond the Trees Avondale: Treetop Walk & Tower
summary: 1.4km treetop walk, 38m viewing tower with slide, house tours, and café in Rathdrum.
description: Beyond the Trees Avondale reopened in June 2022 following a €19 million redevelopment project by Coillte in partnership with Fáilte Ireland and EAK Ireland. Located in Rathdrum, the site features the longest Treetop Walk in Ireland and the UK, stretching 1.4km. This journey through and above the trees culminates at the impressive Viewing Tower, which stands 38m above the forest. From here, visitors reveal panoramic 360-degree views over the Wicklow Mountains, the Avonmore River, and the Vale of Avoca. Both adults and children can opt to whizz back down the tower via the gigantic 90m spiral slide. The venue also offers a complimentary self-guided visit to the Coillte Pavilion, where visitors learn about the evolution of forestry in Ireland. Adjacent to the outdoor dining terrace of the Seed Café is an adventurous children's playground within the picturesque Walled Garden. The café crafts creative food offerings using high quality, local Wicklow ingredients. Guided tours of the historic 18th century Avondale House, titled 'At Home with the Parnells', are available to book in advance from Autumn 2022. These tours encompass the life and times of Charles Stewart Parnell, his mother Delia, and his sisters Fanny and Anna, who were co-founders of the Ladies Land League in 1881. From the Walled Gardens, there is access to the Treetop Walk, a stimulating sensory garden, and forest walking trails.

title: Lough Key Forest & Activity Park
summary: Forest park in Boyle with trails, picnic areas, BBQs, and paid activities like Boda Borg and Zipit.
description: Lough Key Forest & Activity Park is located in Boyle, Co. Roscommon. The venue offers a range of trails for all abilities suitable for walking and cycling. Visitors can enjoy picnics on-site where a large number of picnic tables are provided. Many of these tables include BBQ grills which are free of charge to use. Guests may bring their own games equipment or play in the spacious grounds. For those looking to spend a little more, an exciting range of on-site Pay for Use activities is available, including Boda Borg, Zipit Forest Adventures, Treasure Trail, P Mac Kayaks, Lough Key Boat Tours, and Cé Saunas. Pre-booking is essential for Boda Borg and Zipit Forest Adventures. While it is not strictly necessary for other activities, ringing ahead is recommended to avoid disappointment. Dining options include a terrace and an indoor café where tables can be reserved. The park also allows customization of activities, tours, and private events for groups. The facility includes a Caravan and Camping Park and a Marina Harbour. Staying options are available nearby in the Area. The park hosts events such as the Night and Day Festival, Lough Key Legends Run, Lough Key Triathlon, and Parkrun. A swimming pool is also listed as a feature. The venue has accessibility information available, though specific details on wheelchair or step-free access are not defined in the text provided.

title: Kidspace Rathcoole Superhero Brunch Event
summary: Superhero brunch with Spiderman and Batman on Sun 2 Feb, suitable for children up to 8 years.
description: Kidspace Playcentre, located in Rathcoole, hosts the Superhero Brunch event on Sunday, 2nd February 2025, from 10:00 to 12:00. Spiderman and Batman will visit to meet children in the event area. The venue offers free wifi and has various televisions with Sky Sports. The Nest Café serves delicious coffees, meals, and snacks. Kidspace regularly hosts themed and seasonal events. On the day, children can enjoy a Super Pancake brunch, a super soundtrack for dancing, and learn superhero moves. Little ones are encouraged to come in fancy dress. The venue is open from 9am. The event is suitable for children up to 8 years. Due to space restrictions, only one adult may be able to accompany each child in the event area, though the whole family is welcome to join for photographs. On the day, you have the option to add on kiddie treatments for €5 per head, including face painting and temporary tattoos. Kids can also play in the playframe while adults relax.

title: GoKidsGo | Birthday Parties
summary: Birthday parties including laser games and themed rooms like Princess and Minions.
description:
GoKidsGo specialises in children's birthday parties, offering both laser parties and themed party room experiences. The venue provides themed rooms including Princess, Super Heroes, Minions and Glitter Studio, each designed to create a fun and colourful setting for celebrations. Themed parties include extended playtime and exclusive use of one of the party rooms.

Party packages include playtime, food for children and a private room. Families simply bring the cake and optional party bags, with additional party bags available to purchase on site. Laser parties run seven days a week and are ideal for energetic groups looking for something a little different from traditional soft play. Each party includes organised laser games followed by time in a party room for food and celebrations. Laser parties are priced per child with a minimum group number, though smaller groups can still book and receive the full experience with the minimum charge applying.

A booking deposit is required for parties. Adult numbers are limited per party to ensure comfort and space for children. Laser parties are suitable for confident players. The venue is located at Porters Rd, Coolmine Industrial Estate, Dublin 15, D15 H6TX, Ireland.
